name: martix-git

publisher.name: MartiXDev
publisher.distributionModel: standalone skill with direct Copilot marketplace registration

summary: Standalone-first Git lifecycle guidance for safe branch, commit, pull-request, release, hook, and worktree decisions.
abstract: This package separates Git, GitHub, repository policy, runtime capability, and model suggestions. It routes Conventional Commits, Conventional Branch, SemVer, semantic-release, hooks, pull requests, issue links, and report-first worktree cleanup through explicit evidence and confirmation boundaries.

secondaryTargets: VS Code Copilot clients with user-invoked prompts

contextStrategy: Start with SKILL.md and identify one primary workflow.
Open only the routed rule or reference file needed for the current branch.
Use deterministic adapters and current GitHub evidence for state claims.
Require confirmation before each mutation and re-read state afterward.
